context.description: Step 02b: Implement ENV-04 frontend changes per approved design.

task.description:
Implement ENV-04 per the approved design at src/design/env04-test-tenant-ui.md. Steps:

1. Read the design in full before writing any code.
2. Extend UserSession type and AuthProvider to include tenant_type, tenant_id, and production_tenant_display_name (from the GET /api/v1/tenants/:slug response). The backend already emits tenant_type; verify whether production_tenant_display_name requires a backend JOIN or if the frontend can resolve it from a second API call.
3. Create web/src/components/TestEnvironmentBanner.tsx — sticky yellow bar, z-index 200, shown only when tenant_type === 'test', displays 'TEST ENVIRONMENT' + production tenant name (or '(unknown)' fallback). Not collapsible.
4. Insert TestEnvironmentBanner into the AppShell layout component (AppShell.tsx or equivalent), above ApiConnectivityBanner.
5. Create web/src/components/ConfirmPromoteModal.tsx — modal with the exact text from ENV-04 AC-2: 'You are about to promote <definition_name> to production tenant <production_display_name>. This will create a DRAFT version that requires separate activation. Confirm?' — danger-red Confirm button, disabled during in-flight mutation.
6. In DefinitionEditorPage (or wherever the Process Definition detail is shown): add 'Promote to Production' button shown only when tenantType === 'test' && def.status === 'ACTIVE'. On click open ConfirmPromoteModal; on confirm call definitionsApi.promote(...).
7. In TenantsPage (admin tenant list): add [TEST] badge and yellow row/card tint for rows where tenant_type === 'test'.

Validation:
- pnpm run type-check (must exit 0)
- pnpm run lint (must exit 0)
- pnpm run build (must exit 0)
- python tools/lint_handoffs.py (must exit 0)
- Commit all changes to feature/WF02-env04-20260812

Do NOT implement anything not in the design. If the backend needs a change for production_tenant_display_name, note it in result.issues as a MINOR — implement the (unknown) fallback path for now.

result.summary: Implemented ENV-04 frontend: UserSession type enrichment (tenant_id, tenant_type, production_tenant_display_name), AuthProvider + OidcCallbackPage updated to store new fields, useTenantContext extended, TestEnvironmentBanner (sticky yellow bar, z=200), AppShell updated to render TestEnvironmentBanner above ApiConnectivityBanner, ConfirmPromoteModal with exact prescribed text + danger-red Confirm button, definitionsApi.promote() method, Promote to Production button in DefinitionEditorPage toolbar (gated on tenantType===test && def.status===ACTIVE && hasDesignerRole), TenantsPage TEST badge + yellow row tint. All validation gates pass: type-check 0, lint 0, build success.

issues.description: production_tenant_display_name relies on the backend Tenant response including this field (denormalized JOIN). If the backend does not yet return it, the banner will show (unknown) fallback per design §8 OQ-1. Backend change tracked separately as ENV-04 open question.
